retention.scope: Queue policy, not statistical equivalence or automatic model promotion

initialization: From original seed20262027, no checkpoint warm-start. Every original parameter name/shape/order/value and constructor RNG exact; no new parameters/buffers. Nonidentity modes intentionally change initial outputs/gradients. Identity fixture must reproduce original output and raw gradients.

formula.location: Only second L2 q_norm output before original SDPA; original Wq/Wqi/residual input stays native.
formula.notation: Q1 and Q2 head queries after original q_norm; K original k_norm keys; all per row/head/slot.
formula.near_zero: When Q2 norm or source norm<=1e-12 return original Q2. All denominators safely clamped before branch selection.
formula.gradient: Full autograd through Q1,K,valid mean,source and Q2; no detach or straight-through override.
formula.precision: Original BF16 autocast for original/extra SDPA; FP32 for mean_valid(K),source floor,norm and tangent calculations, then cast transformed Q2 to its original dtype. Centered values cast to K dtype before extra SDPA.
formula.extra_computation: extrapolate caches Q1 only; three key modes perform exactly one additional SDPA after first work attention. Centered adds valid-key mean/subtraction. None add transformer cycles or prediction-to-work feedback.
formula.cleanup: Scoped hooks/tensors released finally each forward; no cross-batch state, module monkeypatching or new optimizer members.

conditional_best_single_comparisons.selection: For each parent, highest macroAUC successful candidate (tie fixed experiment order), only if point macroAUC exceeds best single; at most2 pairs.
conditional_best_single_comparisons.bootstrap: same accepted500user draws/seed20260906; selection-conditional exploratory intervals, not multiplicity or training-seed guarantee.

repair_policy: No optimizer/Q initialization/dense clipping or LR repair. Failed candidate stops and preserves artifacts; no automatic restart. No extra training seed.
interpretation_limits: Prior q4.buy fixed-weight directional dependence motivates factor control but predicts no architecture gain. This is an independently proposed key-feedback/training hypothesis, not a fabricated accepted-tool handoff.
Uniform/attended/centered compare full source and gradient paths, not equal-angle interventions or isolated relevance.
Common K translation cancels in original softmax scores but enters K-as-values feedback. Centering removes the common component in real arithmetic; it is not evidence all-history mean is irrelevant.
No Hopfield convergence/energy theorem is claimed for our two-layer residual,independent Q/K projections and norm-preserving tangent update.
Source floor prevents tiny centroid differences from being promoted to a full unit direction; BF16 rounding still requires smoke validation.
No test evaluation and no new training seed.
